title: Source-faithful Toller identity/collision asymptotics gate
scientific_question: For the published gamma-simple Toller boost matrix elements at fixed j, are the individual causal branches t+ and t- bounded/locally regular as beta -> 0 on the frozen source-faithful grid, and does their recombination remain stable?
scope_guard: This is a local beta->0 source-matrix test, not a proof of full K5 collision integrability.
No conclusion about simultaneous multi-pair collision strata is authorized by this gate alone.
No conclusion about causal-stack normalization, cutoff removal, D7 terminality, or Candidate Gravity is authorized.
A fitted singular power is diagnostic only; it is not by itself a divergence theorem.
